summary: Atmos Energy Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a registered public offering of $700 million aggregate principal amount of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2032. The notes, issued under an existing indenture, are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with its other unsubordinated debt. Net proceeds were approximately $693.9 million after discounts and expenses. Interest is payable semiannually, with maturity on January 15, 2032. The company may redeem the notes at its option. The filing is a routine debt offering under an existing shelf registration statement and does not represent a special situation.
